_doc: Face lane v2: which face each key still wears (faces.v2_face reads this; face_v2_run.py too). Keyed by pose name, then px ('*' = every size, a px key overrides it). expr: confident | focused | smile | hurt | closed; params override the spec's (face_v2.py). Gaze targets: idle and back view at the viewer, N1 at the enemy (the way she faces), Q with closed smiling eyes. Picks from round F1 (ART-RULES learning log).
